purpose: Determine learning effects and concrete benefits/limits of shared BioAgent interfaces, including negative results
scope: Offline simulations and isolated local EVM tests; no live service changes or real trading

lightForaging.constrainedSelection: Existing internal adoption must pass; on ten additional selection seeds require higher mean reward, nondecreasing food, and nonincreasing contacts. Otherwise retain prior policy. Experimental external gate, not a production change.
lightForaging.primaryOutcome: Held-out reward increase with no mean contact increase; report food, collisions, all training seeds and all checkpoints
lightForaging.limitations: Fixed engineered reward; five trained policies; same synthetic task; cannot establish biological-topology superiority

fullForaging.primaryOutcome: Held-out cumulative reward; report food and contacts alongside; two agents share a world so the episode, not each fly, is the independent unit
fullForaging.limitations: Exploratory small sample; artificial mappings; learning changes readout, not biological connectivity; zero-readout baseline has no learned prior

market.execution: Synthetic constant-product quote with fixed 100000-token1 depth anchored to generated prices, 0.3% pool fee, existing 0.001-token1 paper gas. Not Uniswap V3 execution or historical replay.
market.primaryOutcome: Final liquidatable paper equity versus identical frozen-prior run; prediction MSE is not profit
market.limitations: Synthetic prices and quotes; three engineered personalities share code but not a market; no real market or Uniswap cost claims

aqua.primaryOutcome: Error to declared artificial target risk*0.24; action/spread changes and preserved raw-response hard gate
aqua.limitations: Known target rule is an oracle-by-construction diagnostic, not a competitive trading strategy; calibration is not market learning

interfaces.runtime: Same observe/step/snapshot loop over ForagingBioAgent, UniswapPriceBioAgent, UniswapSwapBioAgent, using explicit fixtures
interfaces.negativeControl: Two runtime adapters sharing one Arena: per-agent stepping versus per-environment scheduling
interfaces.onchain: One IBioAgent status update invalidates old-revision strategies in AquaFlyApp and SharedAquaFlyApp; another agent remains usable
interfaces.reuse: Same existing export/restore helper for foraging and market; cross-task/model artifacts must be rejected
interfaces.limits: Solidity IBioAgent is not the JavaScript superclass; applications do not all inherit one learning engine; no external full-profile interoperability claim

reporting: Keep every run including regressions and no-effect. Report descriptive paired results; no post-hoc best-seed pitch. All protocol modifications or harness repairs must be logged. New confirmatory claims need new unseen conditions.
